params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $wt='C:\Users\fengc\agent-worktrees\finish-catalog208'; git -C $wt checkout --theirs -- 'src/MhwModManager.App/MainWindow.xaml'; $f=Join-Path $wt 'src\MhwModManager.App\MainWindow.xaml'; $t=Get-Content -Raw $f; $anchor='                        <Button Content="Install Mod" Command="{Binding ImportArchiveCommand}" Style="{StaticResource QuietButton}" ToolTip="Choose a downloaded mod archive and add it to this game''s library."/>'; if(-not $t.Contains($anchor)){throw 'catalog insertion anchor missing'}; $button='                        <Button Content="Browse Mods" Click="OpenCatalogClick" Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}" ToolTip="Browse supported mod providers, choose exact files, and install through the manager."/>' + [Environment]::NewLine; $t=$t.Replace($anchor,$button+$anchor); Set-Content -LiteralPath $f -Value $t -Encoding UTF8; git -C $wt add 'src/MhwModManager.App/MainWindow.xaml'; Write-Output 'UNMERGED:'; git -C $wt diff --name-only --diff-filter=U; Write-Output 'DIFFCHECK:'; git -C $wt diff --check; Write-Output 'RELEASEDIFF:'; git -C $wt diff --cached origin/main -- VERSION.txt Directory.Build.props README.md CHANGELOG.md _AGENT_CONTEXT/CURRENT_REVISION.json _AGENT_CONTEXT/handoff-manifest.json | Select-Object -First 320; exit 0
